basic_profile.bio: I'm a 39-year-old Pokémon enthusiast based in San Diego, California. During the day, I work as a software developer for a tech startup, but my evenings and weekends are dedicated to Pokémon GO and other gaming adventures. I'm a proud father of two and enjoy spending my free time exploring local parks with my family and participating in community events. My wife and I share a love for travel, and we've been fortunate to visit several countries, where I've made international Pokémon GO friends. I'm typically online during the late evenings, Pacific Time, when the kids are asleep.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in software development, with a degree in Computer Science from UCSD. Over the years, I've developed a keen interest in augmented reality and mobile gaming. My expertise in coding and software architecture allows me to engage deeply with tech-related discussions. I'm also well-versed in Pokémon game strategies, having played since the original Red and Blue versions.
